title: Listening Drill — Winter bird feeding — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Winter bird feeding — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on winter bird feeding last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with spilt seed. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: wet perch.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of feeder height so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow seed bag instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the nature guide before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Wednesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
